context:
Goal: a session on your computer deletes a spent branch when a coordinator asks, without a new ask each time.
Problem (rule): your Oct 30 standing grant lets a session on your computer delete a branch whose last commit is on the default branch or an archive branch, but it names no repo.
Based on (read): .claude/CLAUDE.md, standing grant "Acts the cloud refuses" (owner Oct 30, 16:20 CDT; Cockpit item 219 a).
Departs from: main names no repo for the delete — the grant names its repos.

lastAnswer.note: any shivinate7, ssemwal-cdc, any repo that i'm github logged in to really

options.gain: Spent branches in every repo go without a new ask.
options.how: The grant line gains: in any shivinate7 repo, when that repo's coordinator asks.
options.label: Any shivinate7 repo (Recommended)
options.lose: A delete may happen in a repo you did not name.

options.gain: Each delete stays in the repo that asked.
options.how: The grant line gains: only in the repo of the coordinator that asks.
options.label: Only the asking coordinator's repo
options.lose: A cross-repo cleanup needs your word.

reply: Closed 14:14 CST: the grant covers every repo your GitHub logins reach (shivinate7, ssemwal-cdc). The CLAUDE.md grant line changes in a lane; coordinator told.
title: Which repos your Oct 30 branch-delete grant covers
why: The grant names no repo, and only you can widen or narrow it.
